items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Had it been difficult, guys like Teddy Wilson and Ben Webster and some other guys that I didn't even know had been on staff 10 years before I was on.

ctx.x: Can you give us some names of people you worked with during your tenure in that world? Or people who were active and prominent?

Well, I mentioned some names like Jimmy Nottingham and Joe Waller. Ernie Rall was on staff at ABC. You might know Ernie Rall, his brother worked with Basie’s band. Sad and I worked it CBS Specs Powell worked at CBS for eight years. You know, CBS had people on staff like Ben Webster, Teddy Wilson, people like that. They all quit because they could not make enough money on staff. But, long before we started on staff they had been there. But, there were people like that and some other names. Probably, not well known…
Well, give us some not well-known names.
